parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It serves as a movable cover to enclose and protect the contents of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: A lower cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, attached to the front of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the lower storage compartment of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: An upper cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, attached to the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It covers and protects the upper storage area of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: Another upper cabinet door made of MDF, rectangular in shape, attached to the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides access to the upper right storage compartment.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical hinge axis to open and close.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: The main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, forming the outer shell and support structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides structural integrity and supports the doors and shelves.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving part of the cabinet.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A horizontal shelf made of particle board, rectangular in shape, fitted inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports stored items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A middle shelf made of particle board, rectangular in shape, fitted inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the cabinet space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: An upper shelf made of particle board, rectangular in shape, fitted inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It supports items stored in the upper section of the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf
parts.Basic_description: A top shelf made of particle board, rectangular in shape, fitted inside the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It provides the topmost storage surface inside the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed or occasionally adjustable vertically but does not move during normal use.
